## TL;DR

GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.109 now exposes real `--model` ids (GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6.1 Terra, Claude Haiku 5.5, and others) plus per-model `--reasoning-effort` levels. RepoOS adds a verified catalog in `src/core/copilot-models.ts`, lists Auto tiers and those named models in the Agents picker, forwards `--model` and economical `low` reasoning on runs, and enriches connectivity-test failures with the model and valid reasoning levels. A live probe of `gpt-6-luna` succeeded from this worktree (~0.37 credits per tiny prompt). The budget allowlist row for `github copilot` was **not** changed on this branch — task branches must not land `repoos.toml`; Nick should add the catalog ids to `[[budget.allowlist]]` on `main` himself and unpause when ready.

## Work and rationale

The Copilot agent had been stuck on Auto-only wiring: every run used `--model auto --auto-tier balance`, which was the right fix when `efficiency` disappeared (#1088) but left no way to pin cheap named models from the new CLI picker. Discovery used low-cost techniques first: `copilot --help` documents `--model` and `--reasoning-effort`; invalid `--model` ids return "Model … is not available" without naming alternatives; `providers` is not a non-interactive subcommand. Invalid reasoning levels fail fast with `Reasoning effort "…" is not supported for model "…"`.

Verified model ids with one short prompt each: `gpt-6-luna` (0.37 credits), `gpt-6.1-terra` (3.7), `gpt-5.6-terra` (7.4, left out of catalog as expensive), `claude-haiku-5.5` (0.6). Invalid: `gpt-5.6-sol`, `claude-haiku-5-5`. Reasoning: `gpt-6-luna` supports none and low–max but not minimal; `claude-haiku-5.5` and `gpt-6.1-terra` support low–max but not none/minimal; Auto tiers reject `--reasoning-effort`. RepoOS pins `low` for named catalog models.

The catalog excludes Sonnet, Opus, Fusion, Gemini, Grok, and Kimi per the cheap-models rule. **On close-out:** restore `repoos.toml` on the branch; Nick should mirror `models = ["default", "copilot-auto-efficiency", "copilot-auto-balance", "copilot-auto-intelligence", "gpt-6-luna", "gpt-6.1-terra", "claude-haiku-5.5"]` on the paused `github copilot` allowlist row on `main` when signing off, then `repoos agents resume "github copilot"` if desired.

## Approaches tried

Centralized named models and reasoning in `copilot-models.ts` while keeping Auto tier mapping in `copilot-auto-tier.ts`. Settings labels append a compact reasoning range via `labelForModel`. Default certify/live probe pin moved to `gpt-6-luna`.

## Challenges and blockers

No machine-readable Copilot model list; discovery cost credits. End-to-end dispatch through the paused allowlist was not exercised here.

## Key learnings

Copilot validates reasoning per model; Auto mode must not receive `--reasoning-effort`. Budget allowlist edits belong on `main`, not task branches. Remote gate recovery: the host-lock orphan test ages slots with `utimesSync` instead of `touch -t`, which failed to mark staleness on mini.
